name: Iluka Resources 2025 Annual Report (year ended 31 December 2025)
locator: Printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 2). Chairman/MD review pp.8-9: Eneabba online 2027, engineering >95%, capex A$1.7-1.8B, Lindian agreement, Northern Minerals offtake, Wimmera DFS, metallisation study to conclude 2026. Financial summary pp.11-12: Eneabba capex A$443M in 2025, NTU convertible note redeemed, EFA facility A$1,650M / A$610M drawn / A$150M overrun. Project overview p.21: Eneabba construction status and 2027 commissioning; Wimmera DFS, EES 2026, WSP, resource upgrade Jan 2026. Product stewardship p.29: metallisation and magnet-waste recycling. Remuneration p.53: Lindian 10% of refinery feedstock for 15 years; p.57 fns: 16.0 ktpa REO output on stockpile feed, 23 ktpa total capacity, 18 ktpa max feed. Climate p.79: Eneabba capex committed/spent A$1,134M; p.86: Eneabba and Wimmera long-term assets. Notes 3 (p.108), 5(c) (p.112), 16 (pp.127-128). Mineral Resources p.167: WIM100 re-modelling +3.9 Mt HM.
